from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareCapitalRecord(BaseModel):
    """Share capital information from one quarterly report period."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name (汤臣倍健)")
    reporting_year: int | None = Field(description="The calendar year of the report period")
    reporting_quarter: int | None = Field(description="The quarter (1-4)")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="Report period end date, e.g., '2019-03-31'")
    opening_share_capital: int | None = Field(description="Share capital at beginning of period, in shares")
    closing_share_capital: int | None = Field(description="Share capital at end of period, in shares")
    change_in_shares: int | None = Field(description="Difference between closing and opening; positive = increase, negative = decrease")
    change_reason: str | None = Field(description="Reason for capital change if stated (e.g., stock option exercises), None if no change")
    notes: str | None = Field(description="Additional notes about capital stability or changes mentioned")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the share capital figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_capital_records: list[ShareCapitalRecord]
